The printed statement matches the statute's wording.

The terms page says verbatim that authentications (type, date/time) and signatures (files and metadata) are processed to manage the user's electronic identification, which is what the report prints.

The cited page names IGCP, E.P.E. as the entity managing the State's treasury, financing and direct public debt; it does not mention Direção-Geral do Orçamento (DGO) or ESPAP, which are the bodies the report prints.

Código do Registo Predial art. 107 states verbatim that the president of the Instituto dos Registos e do Notariado, I.P. is the controller of the land-registry databases, matching the printed statement.
Art. 106 states verbatim that the land registry databases organise and keep updated information on the legal status of properties, which the printed statement paraphrases faithfully.

Código do Registo Comercial art. 78-C(1) says verbatim that the director-geral dos Registos e do Notariado is the database controller, but the page never mentions IRN; the printed gloss '(now IRN)' is added from outside the source.
Art. 78-B states verbatim that the commercial registry database organises and keeps updated information on the legal status of entities subject to registration, matching the printed statement.

WebFetch got 'A query falhou!' but a direct download of the same URL returned the Código do Registo Civil; art. 220-B(1) states verbatim that the president of IRN, I.P. is the controller of the civil registry database.
Art. 220-A(1) ('Base de dados do registo civil') states verbatim that the database holds information on nationality, civil status and capacity of citizens, matching the printed name and description.

DL 396/2007 art. 7(5) says the *models* (templates) of diplomas and certificates, defined by portaria, are made available in SIGO, and art. 11(2) says training actions are inscribed in SIGO; it does not say that qualification diplomas and certificates themselves are made available in SIGO, as printed.
Lei 58/2005 art. 7(1) states verbatim that the body exercising the powers of the law is the Agência Portuguesa do Ambiente, I.P., as national water authority, matching the printed statement.
DL 86/2000 art. 15 states verbatim 'O IRN, I. P., é o organismo responsável pelo SIPEP', the passport information system, matching the printed statement.

Lei 4/2007 art. 99(1) states verbatim that natural and legal persons relating to the social security system are subject to identification in the information system; the printed sentence is a faithful rendering and adds no name the law does not give.

Lei 37/2015 art. 38(1) states verbatim that the Direção-Geral da Administração da Justiça is the entity responsible for the criminal identification databases, and registocriminal.justica.gov.pt confirms DGAJ/DSIC; matches the printed statement.

Portaria 22/2016 art. 12(1) says only that SINAVE uses the Registo Nacional de Utentes to look up patient identification for the physician profile; it does not say the register is the identification reference for 'other national health systems' generally, and the abbreviation RNU does not appear.
